proposal.summary: The report describes a visual layout bug on the checkout page in Firefox 128 where the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when the window is narrower than 600px.

A.quote: on the checkout page in Firefox 128, the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when the window is narrower than 600px.

proposal.recommended_next_step: No security action needed. Route to the frontend/UI engineering team to fix the CSS/layout so the button wraps beneath the order total at widths under 600px; include browser/version and reproduction steps.

evidence_quotes.quote: on the checkout page in Firefox 128, the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when the window is narrower than 600px.
Steps: open cart, resize window, look at the right column.
Expected: button wraps below the total. Not a security issue, just layout.
